# 给定落脚位置生成 ZMP/质心轨迹时，为什么需要读取未来支撑参考？

> **当前答案：** Kajita 2003 将步态生成写成 ZMP 跟踪伺服；在论文参数下，1.6 秒预览能让 CoM 在支撑切换前响应，而 0.8 秒预览跟踪不足。可复用的是未来参考前馈、当前状态反馈和模型误差修正结构，不是 1.6 秒这一跨机器人常数，也不是完整实机稳定保证。

## 关键术语

- 逆运动学（Inverse Kinematics, IK）
- 惯性测量单元（Inertial Measurement Unit, IMU）
- 质心（Center of Mass, CoM）

## 适用机器人

- HRP-2P model in the paper; other robots require new gains and validation

## 适用模拟器

- OpenHRP in the reported experiment

## 控制器与方法

- ZMP preview walking-pattern generator
- downstream whole-body inverse kinematics/control

## 适用环境

- planned biped walking with prescribed footholds
- paper-reported spiral-stair simulation

## 成立假设

- Future foothold timing and ZMP reference are known over a finite horizon.
- The 3D-LIPM/cart-table approximation and fixed-height assumptions are acceptable as a nominal planner.

## 排查与验证

- 先核对适用机器人、模拟器、控制器、环境和成立假设，再沿下方证据定位复核原始实验或实现。

## 结果

- Kajita 2003 将步态生成写成 ZMP 跟踪伺服；在论文参数下，1.6 秒预览能让 CoM 在支撑切换前响应，而 0.8 秒预览跟踪不足。可复用的是未来参考前馈、当前状态反馈和模型误差修正结构，不是 1.6 秒这一跨机器人常数，也不是完整实机稳定保证。

## 限制

- Future foothold timing and ZMP reference are known over a finite horizon.
- The 3D-LIPM/cart-table approximation and fixed-height assumptions are acceptable as a nominal planner.

- 本页是证据导航，不是可直接执行的实机控制指令；涉及硬件时仍需仿真验证、限幅、保护装置和人工审核。

## 证据

- [Biped Walking Pattern Generation by Using Preview Control of Zero-Moment Point](<https://doi.org/10.1109/ROBOT.2003.1241826>) — `support/primary`；Equations 12-15; Figures 6-8 and 10-13；Derives integral/state/preview feedback, compares preview horizons, quantifies multibody ZMP correction, and reports only simulated spiral-stair walking.
- [Kajita 2003 ZMP preview-control official-code status](<https://doi.org/10.1109/ROBOT.2003.1241826>) — `context/secondary`；Official-code status audit accessed 2026-08-12；Records that no version-pinned author implementation was found, limiting claims about code-level reproducibility.
